verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

translations.text: Ha Mim
Haa Meem

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

translations.text: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
Kasam hai is kitaab e Mubeen ki

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

translations.text: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
Ke humne isey ek badi khair o barakat wali raat mein nazil kiya hai, kyunke hum logon ko mutanabbeh (warning) karne ka irada rakhte thay

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

translations.text: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
Yeh woh raat thi jismein har maamle ka hakeemana faisla

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

translations.text: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
Hamare hukum se sadir kiya jata hai. Hum ek Rasool bhejne waley thay

verses.text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
Tere Rubb ki rehmat ke taur par.Yaqeenan wahi sab kuch sunne aur jaanne wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
Aasmano aur zameen ka Rubb aur har us cheez ka Rubb jo Aasman o zameen ke darmiyan hai agar tum log waqaii yakeen rakhne waley ho

verses.text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
Koi maabood uske siwa nahin hai. Wahi zindagi ata karta hai aur wahi maut deta hai.Tumhara Rubb aur tumhare un aslaaf (forefathers) ka Rubb jo pehle guzar chuke hain

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.text: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
(Magar fil-waqeh in logon ko yaqeen nahin hai) balke yeh apne shakk mein paday khel rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
Accha intezar karo us din ka jab aasman sareeh dhuwan (smoke) liye huey aayega

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.text: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
Aur woh logon par chaa jayega, yeh hai dardnaak saza

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
(Ab kehte hain ke) “ parwardigar , humpar se yeh azaab taal de, hum imaan laatey hain”

verses.text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
Inki gaflat kahan dur hoti hai? Inka haal to yeh hai ke in ke paas Rasool e mubeen aa gaya

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

translations.text: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
Phir bhi yeh uski taraf multafit na huey aur kaha ke “ yeh to sikhaya padaya bawla hai (well-tutored madman)”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

translations.text: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
Hum zara azaab hataye detay hain, tum log phir wahi kuch karoge jo pehle kar rahe thay

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

translations.text: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
Jis roz hum badi zarb (assault) lagayenge woh din hoga jab hum tumse intiqaam lenge

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

translations.text: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
Hum insey pehle Firaun ki qaum ko isi aazmaish mein daal chuke hain. Unke paas ek nihayat shareef Rasool aaya

verses.text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.text: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
Aur usne kaha “Allah ke bandon ko mere hawale karo, main tumhare liye ek amanat-daar Rasool hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
Allah ke muqable mein sarkashi na karo. Main tumhare saamne (apni maamuriyat ki) sareeh sanad (clear authority) pesh karta hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

translations.text: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
Aur main apne Rubb aur tumhare Rubb ki panaah le chuka hoon issey ke tum mujhpar hamla-awar (attack) ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

translations.text: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
Agar tum meri baat nahin maante to mujhpar haath daalne se baaz raho”

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

translations.text: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
Aakhir e kaar usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke yeh log mujrim hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

translations.text: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
(Jawab diya gaya) accha to raat-o-raat mere bandon (servants) ko lekar chal padh. Tum logon ka peecha kiya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

translations.text: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
Samandar ko uske haal par khula chodh de.Yeh saara lashkar garq (drown) honay wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.text: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
Kitne hi baag aur chasme

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.text: many a cornfield and noble building,
Aur kheit (gardens) aur shaandaar mahal thay jo woh chodh gaye

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

translations.text: many a thing in which they had delighted:
Kitne hi aish ke sar-o-samaan, jin mein woh mazey kar rahey thay unke pichey dharay reh gaye

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

translations.text: We gave these to another people to inherit.
Yeh hua unka anjaam, aur humne dusron ko in cheezon ka waris bana diya

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

translations.text: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
Phir na aasman unpar roya na zameen, aur zara si mohalat bhi unko na di gayi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

translations.text: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
Is taraah bani Israel ko humne sakht zillat ke azaab

verses.text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.text: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
Firoun se najaat di jo hadd se guzar janey walon mein fil waqeh badey unchey darje ka aadmi tha

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: We chose them knowingly above others:
Aur unki halat jaante huye, unko duniya ki dursi qaumon par tarjeeh di

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
Aur unhein aisi nishaniya dikhayi jin mein sareeh aazmaish thi

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

translations.text: These people here assert,
Yeh log kehte hain

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

translations.text: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
“hamari pehli maut ke siwa aur kuch nahin uske baad hum dobara uthaye jaane wale nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

translations.text: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
Agar tum sacchey ho to utha lao hamare baap dada ko”

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

translations.text: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
Yeh behtar hai ya tubbah ki qaum aur ussey pehle ke log? Humne unko isi bina par tabah kiya ke woh mujrim ho gaye thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

translations.text: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
Yeh Aasman o zameen aur inke darmiyan ki cheezein humne kuch khel ke taur par nahin bana di hai

verses.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
Inko humne bar-haqq paida kiya hai, magar aksar log jaante hain hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
In sabke uthaye janey ke liye the-shuda waqt faisle ka din hai

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.text: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
Woh din jab koi azeez kareeb apne kisi azeez kareeb ke kuch bhi kaam nahin aayega. Aur na kahin se unhein koi madad pahunchegi

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.text: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
Siwaye iske ke Allah hi kisi par reham karey, woh zabardast aur Raheem hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

translations.text: The tree of Zaqqum
Zakkhum ka darakht (tree)

verses.text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

translations.text: will be food for the sinners:
Gunahgaar ka kha-ja (khana /food) hoga

verses.text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

translations.text: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
Tail (oil) ki tiljhat (dregs) jaisa, pait (bellies) mein is tarah josh khayega

verses.text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

translations.text: like seething water.
Jaise khaulta (boiling) hua pani josh khata hai

verses.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.text: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
Pakado isey aur raged-te (dragging) huey le jao isko jahannum ke beechon beech

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

translations.text: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
Aur undhail (pour) do iske sar par khaulte (boiling) paani ka azaab

verses.text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

translations.text: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
Chakkh iska maza, bada zabardast izzatdaar aadmi hai tu

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

translations.text: This is what you doubted.’
Yeh wahi cheez hai jiske aane mein tumlog shakk rakhte thay”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

translations.text: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
Khuda tars log aman ki jagah mein hongey

verses.text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.text: amid Gardens and springs,
Baaghon (gardens) aur chashmo mein

verses.text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

translations.text: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
Hareer-o-deeba (silk and brocade) ke libas pehne, aamne saamne baithey honge

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

translations.text: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
Yeh hogi inki shaan aur hum gori gori aah-o-chashm auratein unse biyah denge

verses.text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

translations.text: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
Wahan woh itminaan se har tarah ki lazeez cheezein talab karenge

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.text: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
Wahan maut ka maza woh kabhi na chakhenge . Bas duniya mein jo maut aa chuki so aa chuki aur Allah apne fazal se

verses.text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

translations.text: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
Unko jahannum ke azaab se bacha dega yahi badi kamiyabi hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
Aey Nabi (s.a.s) humne is kitaab ko tumhari zubaan mein sahal (easy / aasaan) bana diya hai taake yeh log nasihat hasil karein

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

translations.text: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
Ab tum bhi intezar karo, yeh bhi muntazir (intezar kar rahey) hain
